Wallet.signInRequired: Sign in to view your live balance
Wallet.chargeBody: Pick a tiered charge package and set your auto-refill and secure-invoice options. Real payment activates once the payment gateway is connected.
Wallet.currencyNote: 1 U-Coin = 1 EUR (local currency automatically converted at checkout).
Wallet.balanceBody: Manage your live U-COIN balance, ledger integrity, per-module spend simulation, and auto-spending limit in one place.

summaryHint.title: Real-time available balance
summaryHint.description: Your current balance read straight from the Supabase wallet ledger, plus the amount reserved by auto-spending and your ledger-based lifetime spend.
summaryHint.howto: Press Refresh to re-pull the latest ledger state. The reserved figure tracks your auto-spending limit setting.
summaryHint.caution: Reserved and lifetime figures are a summary over your 12 most recent ledger rows, not your full history.

bal.historySignedOut: Sign in to see your recent transactions and their integrity check.
bal.historyUnavailable: Ledger service is unreachable. Try again after the gateway is connected.

historyHint.title: Transaction history real-time verification
historyHint.description: Loads recent rows from the append-only coin_ledger and re-derives, in the browser, whether each row's balance chains exactly to the one before it.
historyHint.howto: A green shield above the balance deltas means the ledger chain and your current balance agree.
historyHint.caution: This is a local check over the 12 most recent rows. Full audit is done separately by server-side reconciliation.

bal.simIntro: Pick the modules and how many times you'll use them to instantly compute the spend and remaining balance.
bal.simInsufficient: The selected mix exceeds your current balance.

simHint.title: Per-module coin-consumption simulator
simHint.description: Pre-computes total spend from the real coin unit costs of the 11 cognitive ecosystems and 5 live-service modules.
simHint.howto: Adjust each module's count with + / − and the totals and remaining balance update live.
simHint.caution: The result is an estimate. Real debits happen only via spend_coins when you enter each module.

bal.autoNote: The setting is stored locally in this browser; auto-spending execution applies once the payment gateway is connected.

autoHint.title: Auto-spending limit
autoHint.description: Sets the maximum coin amount auto-approved without a confirmation step during the chosen window.
autoHint.howto: Enter a limit and window and it saves locally at once. Any spend above the limit always asks for manual confirmation.
autoHint.caution: A high limit can allow unintended back-to-back spends. Disable it on shared devices.

chg.packagesIntro: Choose Starter, Pro or Sovereign to match how you use the platform. Higher tiers carry a larger bonus.

tierDesc.starter: Base charge for light, occasional users
tierDesc.pro: Bonus-included charge for regular module users
tierDesc.sovereign: Maximum-bonus charge for heavy or team use

packagesHint.title: Tiered smart charge packages
packagesHint.description: Compares each package's base coins, bonus coins, EUR price and effective per-coin cost.
packagesHint.howto: Select a package to see the projected balance after charging. The 'Best value' badge marks the lowest per-coin cost.
packagesHint.caution: Prices are shown excluding VAT; the final amount depends on the exchange and tax rates at checkout.

chg.gatewayNote: Payment integration for this portal is in progress. For now you can charge from the main Secure Portal.

gatewayHint.title: Instant payment gateway
gatewayHint.description: Shows the live connection status of the Stripe card channel and the Web3 on-chain channel.
gatewayHint.howto: When a status light turns green, that channel is ready for instant payment.
gatewayHint.caution: While a channel is pending, no payment is processed and nothing is charged.

chg.autoRefillNote: The setting is stored locally in this browser; auto-refill execution applies once the payment gateway is connected.

autoRefillHint.title: Auto-refill threshold
autoRefillHint.description: Schedules an automatic charge with the chosen package whenever your balance drops to or below the threshold.
autoRefillHint.howto: Pick a threshold and refill package and it saves at once. It runs automatically once the gateway is connected and the condition is met.
autoRefillHint.caution: Setting the threshold too high can trigger frequent auto-charges. Check your payment method's limit too.

chg.invoiceIntro: Store the details you need for business billing and a tax-invoice-format document is issued when a charge completes.
chg.invoicePending: Issuance activates once the payment gateway is connected.

invoiceHint.title: Secure invoice issuance
invoiceHint.description: A signed PDF invoice issued in the name of THE UNITAS GLOBAL OÜ, including the VAT number and payment reference.
invoiceHint.howto: Save your entity, VAT and recipient email once and invoices are sent automatically from your next charge onward.
invoiceHint.caution: The details you enter are used only for invoicing. An invalid VAT number can delay tax processing.

ErrorBoundary.title: Sovereign Core Error
ErrorBoundary.body: A critical fault occurred in the sovereign infrastructure layer. No further detail is shown here for security compliance -- our systems have been notified.

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: Resonant signal analysis that reflects your query back through layered cognitive echoes.
echo.rules: Each query ripples through three reflection cycles before surfacing an answer.

void.title: Void
void.description: Strips a problem down to its negative space -- what is missing, not what is present.
void.rules: Submit a thesis; Void returns only what breaks it.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: A full-spectrum self-diagnostic scan of behavioral and cognitive patterns.
mirror.rules: One scan per session; results are sealed to your identity alone.

oracle.title: Oracle
oracle.description: Probabilistic foresight modeling for decisions with long, uncertain horizons.
oracle.rules: Ask one question at a time; Oracle answers in probabilities, never certainties.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Real-time vitals for markets, sentiment, and momentum -- read before it moves.
pulse.rules: Live feed; each session monitors one signal at a time.

apex.title: Apex
apex.description: High-stakes performance simulation under a hard countdown clock.
apex.rules: The timer does not pause. Submit before zero or the run is forfeit.

genesis.title: Genesis
genesis.description: First-principles construction: build an idea up from nothing but its axioms.
genesis.rules: Start from zero assumptions; Genesis rejects any premise it cannot derive.

syndicate.title: Syndicate
syndicate.description: Coalition-mapping across hidden networks of influence and affiliation.
syndicate.rules: Access requires a named target entity; results are network graphs, not verdicts.

aura.title: Aura
aura.description: Ambient emotional-field sensing tuned to the tone beneath your words.
aura.rules: No direct questions -- Aura reads tone, not text.

paradox.title: Paradox
paradox.description: Stress-tests an idea by running it backward through its own logic.
paradox.rules: Submit a conclusion; Paradox rewinds it to find where it contradicts itself.

chronos.title: Chronos
chronos.description: Long-cycle historical pattern modeling across decades, not headlines.
chronos.rules: Minimum query horizon: ten years. Chronos does not answer same-day questions.

ModuleEngine.echoQueryPlaceholder: What are you actually deciding here?
ModuleEngine.genesisAxiomPriceCost: Price does not exceed unit cost -- this premise cannot be derived into a sustainable model.
ModuleEngine.genesisAxiomCustomers: Zero starting customers -- there is no base to construct growth from.
ModuleEngine.genesisVerdictRejected: Genesis rejects this premise -- resolve the axiom violations before a structure can be derived.
ModuleEngine.genesisVerdictBreakeven: Derived: the model reaches breakeven within the 12-month horizon.
ModuleEngine.genesisVerdictNoBreakeven: Derived: this model does not reach breakeven within a 12-month horizon at the given axioms.
ModuleEngine.apexPrompt: A competitor just undercut your price by 30% with the market closing in seconds. Choose your move.
ModuleEngine.apexOptionMatchRationale: Protects volume but erodes margin across your whole base, not just contested customers.
ModuleEngine.apexOptionHoldRationale: Slower but preserves margin -- only works if the differentiation is real, not assumed.
ModuleEngine.apexOptionBundleLabel: Reprice via a bundle instead of a discount
ModuleEngine.apexOptionBundleRationale: Defends the headline price while still moving on effective cost -- the highest-leverage response of the three.
ModuleEngine.apexForfeitVerdict: Forfeit -- the timer does not pause.
ModuleEngine.apexForfeitRationale: No choice reached the clock in time.
ModuleEngine.voidThesisPlaceholder: State the plan or claim you want stress-tested
ModuleEngine.voidVerdictClean: Void found no structural gap in this pass -- that does not mean none exists.
ModuleEngine.voidVerdictBroken: Void found what breaks this thesis. Address the gaps above before committing to it.
ModuleEngine.voidGapLegal: No mention of legal or compliance exposure.
ModuleEngine.voidGapFinancial: No mention of cost, revenue, or margin assumptions.
ModuleEngine.voidGapCompetitive: No mention of competitors or alternatives.
ModuleEngine.voidGapOperational: No mention of execution, team, or timeline.

ModuleEngine.paradoxClaimPlaceholder: State the conclusion you want stress-tested
ModuleEngine.paradoxNoFindings: No contradiction pattern detected in this pass.
ModuleEngine.paradoxAbsoluteClaim: An absolute claim is one counterexample away from breaking.
ModuleEngine.paradoxSelfContradiction: This claim hedges and asserts absolutely in the same breath -- pick one.
ModuleEngine.paradoxCircular: This justifies itself by restating itself -- that isn't a reason.
ModuleEngine.paradoxUnderspecified: Too short to stress-test meaningfully -- state the full claim.
ModuleEngine.paradoxVerdictBroken: Paradox found where this contradicts itself.
ModuleEngine.paradoxVerdictHeld: This conclusion held up against the backward pass.
